keys: Tape the leak on the water main (walk round the rock!).
en: Tape the leak on the water main (walk round the rock!).

keys: Tape the leak at the SOUTH POLE (keep walking, gravity follows you).
en: Tape the leak at the SOUTH POLE (keep walking, gravity follows you).

keys: Fix the bridge pipe between the rocks (float the piece into the gap).
en: Fix the bridge pipe between the rocks (float the piece into the gap).

keys: Carry both goo canisters to the tank on the little moon.
en: Carry both goo canisters to the tank on the little moon.

keys: Plunge the clog on the moon's far side.
en: Plunge the clog on the moon's far side.

keys: Welcome to the Waterworks! Mind the drop. There's no drop. There's no down. Good luck!
en: Welcome to the Waterworks! Mind the drop. There's no drop. There's no down. Good luck!

keys: Drifted off into space! Reprinting plumber...
en: Drifted off into space! Reprinting plumber...

keys: Lost in space! Back you come.
en: Lost in space! Back you come.

keys: Welcome aboard The Rusty Pipe! JOB CONSOLE picks a job, the MIRROR changes your look. Tools are on the rack.
en: Welcome aboard The Rusty Pipe! JOB CONSOLE picks a job, the MIRROR changes your look. Tools are on the rack.

keys:
HOLD THE RAIL
WHEN IT FLIPS!
en:
HOLD THE RAIL
WHEN IT FLIPS!

keys: Grab the TAPE (rack, Grab R) and tape the leaky sink!
en: Grab the TAPE (rack, Grab R) and tape the leaky sink!

keys: Tape the shower leak (hop on the step).
en: Tape the shower leak (hop on the step).

keys: Pull the gravity switch. Hold the rail or use BOOTS!
en: Pull the gravity switch. Hold the rail or use BOOTS!

keys: Walk on the ceiling and tape the leak up there!
en: Walk on the ceiling and tape the leak up there!

keys: Crank the main valve shut with the WRENCH.
en: Crank the main valve shut with the WRENCH.

keys: Ah, the Orbital Bathroom. Our most... aromatic module. Let's fix it!
en: Ah, the Orbital Bathroom. Our most... aromatic module. Let's fix it!

keys: Gravity flip in 3! Grab the rail or BOOTS ON!
en: Gravity flip in 3! Grab the rail or BOOTS ON!

keys: That's going on your report card!
en: That's going on your report card!

keys: COOLANT ROOM: tape both coolant leaks.
en: COOLANT ROOM: tape both coolant leaks.

keys: WASTE ROOM: two plumbers on the big valve!
en: WASTE ROOM: two plumbers on the big valve!

keys: Carry the feed pipe from Coolant to the reactor wall.
en: Carry the feed pipe from Coolant to the reactor wall.

keys: Pull BOTH room switches to aim the reactor's gravity.
en: Pull BOTH room switches to aim the reactor's gravity.

keys: FEED THE GREAT CLOG GOO UNTIL IT BURSTS!
en: FEED THE GREAT CLOG GOO UNTIL IT BURSTS!

keys: Fill the emergency tank in the Waste room.
en: Fill the emergency tank in the Waste room.

keys: This is it, plumbers. The reactor. The pipes. The PANIC. Let's fix the whole station!
en: This is it, plumbers. The reactor. The pipes. The PANIC. Let's fix the whole station!

keys: Flushed into the reactor! It's fine. Probably.
en: Flushed into the reactor! It's fine. Probably.

keys: FLOOR 1: tape the leak before the spin!
en: FLOOR 1: tape the leak before the spin!

keys: FLOOR 2: tape the leak on the right wall.
en: FLOOR 2: tape the leak on the right wall.

keys: FLOOR 2: plunge the clog high on the right wall.
en: FLOOR 2: plunge the clog high on the right wall.

keys: FLOOR 3: crank the valve on the ceiling.
en: FLOOR 3: crank the valve on the ceiling.

keys: FLOOR 3: hit the relay switch to drop everything onto FLOOR 4.
en: FLOOR 3: hit the relay switch to drop everything onto FLOOR 4.

keys: FLOOR 4: get both canisters into the wall tank (it only fills when FLOOR 4 is down!).
en: FLOOR 4: get both canisters into the wall tank (it only fills when FLOOR 4 is down!).

keys: The Spin-Cycle Habitat! Every half minute, down moves to the next wall. Plan ahead, plumbers!
en: The Spin-Cycle Habitat! Every half minute, down moves to the next wall. Plan ahead, plumbers!

keys: Spin cycle! Next floor coming up!
en: Spin cycle! Next floor coming up!

keys: Floors are walls, walls are floors!
en: Floors are walls, walls are floors!

keys: Tape up the leaky orange pipe!
en: Tape up the leaky orange pipe!

keys: Crank the red valve with the wrench.
en: Crank the red valve with the wrench.

keys: Plunge the purple clog until it pops.
en: Plunge the purple clog until it pops.

keys: Fill the tank with goo (canisters count!).
en: Fill the tank with goo (canisters count!).

keys: Welcome to the workshop, plumbers! Everything here is broken. On purpose. Mostly.
en: Welcome to the workshop, plumbers! Everything here is broken. On purpose. Mostly.

keys: Uh oh. Floors are optional now!
en: Uh oh. Floors are optional now!

keys: Hold on to something! Or someone!
en: Hold on to something! Or someone!

keys: Flushed! We'll print you a new one.
en: Flushed! We'll print you a new one.

keys: Tape the leaking soda pipe in the kitchen.
en: Tape the leaking soda pipe in the kitchen.

keys: Fetch the floating goo canisters into the kitchen tank (try the G-WRENCH!).
en: Fetch the floating goo canisters into the kitchen tank (try the G-WRENCH!).

keys: Plunge the food chute clog (anchor with the plunger first!).
en: Plunge the food chute clog (anchor with the plunger first!).

keys: Turn the cooler valve - it takes TWO plumbers!
en: Turn the cooler valve - it takes TWO plumbers!

keys: Float the feed pipe back to the kitchen wall.
en: Float the feed pipe back to the kitchen wall.

keys: Seal the ceiling drip over the dining hall.
en: Seal the ceiling drip over the dining hall.

keys: Lunch time! The cafeteria's gravity generator is on its break. Again.
en: Lunch time! The cafeteria's gravity generator is on its break. Again.

keys: Five stars. For the plumbing. Not the food.
en: Five stars. For the plumbing. Not the food.

keys: Back to the kitchen with you!
en: Back to the kitchen with you!
